channel.title: Developer Messaging Lab
channel.description: The latest posts from Developer Messaging Lab

item.title: Hello World
item.description: The first sample post for this blog built with Hexo.

item.title: Microsoft Graph email attachments
item.description: Understand the file, item, inline, and cloud attachment types in Exchange Online when using Microsoft Graph.

item.title: Create a draft meeting with Microsoft Graph
item.description: Learn how to create a draft meeting with Microsoft Graph and send it when it is ready.

item.title: A Script to Get Exchange Server Build Numbers
item.description: A record of publishing a PowerShell script on GitHub that looks up an Exchange server build number by product version. It has since become a PowerShell Module also available on the PowerShell Gallery.

item.title: Adding an alias to the output of Get-MailboxStatistics
item.description: How to add a mailbox alias to the output of Get-MailboxStatistics in PowerShell, and the Get-MailboxStatisticsAndAlias command published on GitHub.

item.title: How EwsAllowList / EwsBlockList behaves
item.description: EwsAllowList / EwsBlockList set with Set-CasMailbox ignore case when you register a value, but the actual match against the connecting application's user agent is case sensitive.

item.title: Exporting a hashtable to CSV in PowerShell
item.description: How to correctly export a PowerShell hashtable to a CSV file, and how the same technique fixes the missing Recipients column from Get-MessageTrackingLog.

item.title: Sending a digitally signed email from .NET Framework
item.description: SmtpClient in .NET Framework has no built-in way to digitally sign or encrypt a message, so this post builds the S/MIME MIME data by hand to send a digitally signed email.

item.title: Exchange Server 2016 Released
item.description: A record of checking Exchange Server 2016 after its official release, including coexistence with Exchange 2013, shared architecture, and the Office file preview limitation in OWA.

item.title: Setting calendar folder permissions by piping the output of Get-Mailbox
item.description: A PowerShell function that takes the output of Get-Mailbox through the pipeline and sets calendar folder permissions for many mailboxes at once.

item.title: Sending a quick test email from PowerShell with SmtpClient
item.description: A PowerShell script that uses the SmtpClient class to send quick test emails with a random sender address and subject so nothing collides.

item.title: Exchange Server 2016 Preview
item.description: A record of installing the Exchange Server 2016 Preview and checking its build number and the "Birthday calendar" feature.

item.title: Viewing your Outlook.com calendar in Sunrise Calendar
item.description: How to view your Outlook.com calendar in Sunrise Calendar, by adding your Outlook.com account to an Android device as an ActiveSync account.

item.title: Using basic authentication with the Outlook REST API
item.description: Learn how to quickly try the Outlook REST API with basic authentication, using Postman as an example.

item.title: How to Programmatically Query the Exchange Server Address Book
item.description: Since EWS has no way to query the address book, this article introduces how to get address book information programmatically using LDAP (System.DirectoryServices) or the Exchange Management Shell.

item.title: Trying out the EWS Java API
item.description: I'll introduce the steps necessary to use the EWS Java API in Eclipse and how to resolve exceptions that arose from dependencies.
